value.title: Coder u6 — re-point: shim serve-or-refuse, skills, API doc

sections.name: mission
sections.value: Build u6 on the merged checkpoint: exhaustive rs serve-or-refuse, complete v2 envelope parity, stable fixture promotion, tracked skill/API docs. Preserve shipped controls/bg. Production/chainglass evidence stays prime-owned.

value.text: FIRST set cwd /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/fs3-rs-governance-port-u6; ABSOLUTE paths for all file tools because spawn root is main. Load BOTH pij and builder skills. Read this packet, your impl-guide row, and canonical governance routes/events JSON before proposing changes.

Canary + ACK before code: run pij whoami and quote exact output, quote actual OMP footer model/effort, then numbered implementation plan and evidence-backed seam questions via pij_send to pij-lonely-ikrie. Model is github-copilot/gpt-6-astra-1m high on OMP. Wait for PM to rule ack.

Author named baseline-compatible HTTP/CLI regressions and unit tests FIRST. Consume canonical contract fixtures rather than restating schemas. No compile-error-only RED; regression must run against old route behavior. PM owns RED/GREEN execution receipts.

CONCURRENT EDIT WAVE: skip every build/test/formatter/linter/harness boot/check and do not commit. Author source/tests, then report READY_TO_VALIDATE with exact commands, source hashes and a snap-in recipe. Pause writes but keep semantic waiting, NEVER HOLD: HOLD strands parent messages. PM validates after the edit barrier; READY is not DONE.

Stay in your owned fence. Migration owner for this unit: none; use existing SqliteOrchestration/shared pool, never duplicate SQL in daemon/core. PM owns all common lib.rs/module/Route/Services/CLI wiring and dependency metadata.

Follow governance-routes.json#isolation for any later runtime proof: private port/state-dir/HOME/Claude+XDG homes/TMUX socket for daemon AND clients. Never main writes, main node_modules writes, npm install/ci in main, port7461 fixtures, global links/settings writes, production restart/bounce, flowspace3 daemon, or omp update. Never inspect pij inbox logs.

Use flowspace3 search before meaning-shaped discovery (client only), exact grep for identifiers, LSP for symbols but scope-check: worktree LSP can index main and falsely return zero refs. Record friction with harness observe; never drain or clear buffers.
Report start/end via pij-rs report now; messages via pij_send to PM. OMP may misroute live parent messages into internal scouts: explicitly relay to main context. Do not infer silence means approval.

READY receipt assets/receipt-u6.json includes changed paths, constructor signatures/call order/CLI Route match arms, named tests and pre-fix RED strategy, toolchain versions, and ASSUMPTIONS about sibling state/order/ownership. No stubs, fake fallbacks, unimplemented subverbs, or undocumented scope cuts.

Clean cutover: every verb in the actual current skill CLI table serves rs or returns named E-RS-UNPORTED, never silent legacy fallback (including absent daemon, missing credentials and unlisted leaves). Preserve already shipped main controls, compact-self and bg jobs; do not reimplement, remove or mislabel them as old non-goals. No new transport or queue cancellation.

The fence includes adapters/generation-router.ts and tests. rs-native --json preserves the complete original v2 envelope: no data-only unwrap, rename projection or rewrapper. GET filters and POST argv/caller share daemon semantics. Generate native/shim byte-parity goldens ONLY on the post-main-merge source; raise any Rust CLI prerequisite before editing outside your fence.

The enforcement test READS the actual skill CLI-verb table against route/refusal inventory; adding a synthetic table verb must fail. Do not duplicate the table in the test. Enumerate every formerly silent-legacy verb that becomes refused for prime rollout notice.

Repoint the actual tracked peer/node/prime/ops/routing skill sources and docs/how/pij-rs-api.md. Document auth trust, role joins, Hello/Event JSON-string payloads, cursor maps, every governance route, current-parent decisions, exact ps header absence, lease-id requirements, terminal-only answer supersede, in-transit limitation and E-RS-ANSWER-AUTHORITY-SPLIT for mixed/fake queues/spines. Production/chainglass confirmation is prime-owned; no fabricated acceptance.

Promote canonical runtime/API fixtures into stable crates/testkit/fixtures/golden/api/ paths before archive. Migrate EVERY permanent include_str!/test fixture literal, including new governance_boot workflow and recovery/backend fixtures; update MANIFEST through existing patterns. Fixture-path-only edits in all affected Rust tests are authorized, not business-logic edits. Historical active-plan copies remain receipts, never a second live schema. Archiving must not break compile or refusal ledger links.

Prime-approved interface cutover: destructive baton return/reclaim REQUIRE --lease-id <observed lease> from grant/show. Missing/mismatch E-RS-LEASE-STALE names current lease and fix; old shim caller must refuse, never silently resolve current-holder-only. Update every skill route example. Rebase permanent refusal ledger pointers/fixture include paths through archive; prefer stable API unsupported-status documentation over a removed active-plan path.

Required source baseline includes merge d0cd734c0c1575881e6a334fdf8cacf01930688b of origin/main63988ededb9a62a7e45cbd68b36e930b0631593b (PR381). Keep background migration0017, controls and governance resolver. Prime-approved existing pij-team guide stays at plan root; do not migrate it to assets. Formal review nodes remain pending final pinned cross-model review.

PM owns composition and shared interfaces. For an owned product-policy question, follow pij context-owner doctrine: ask prime directly and send the PM the pointer; never use a modal question UI. Do not infer permission from silence.
DEFER to the PM: interface changes (they affect sibling units), dependency additions, schema/migration changes, anything outside your paths.
Your evidence outranks the packet: if the brief is wrong, say so at ack or stop-and-ask with the measurement — do not silently code around it.
